output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply and mintedAmount are added without checking if the total supply exceeds the maximum value a uint256 can store, causing a buy function to be devalued.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if the balance is large, causing funds to be frozen in users accounts.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if the balance is large, causing funds to be frozen in users accounts.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value can be of a large magnitude, causing an overflow in the buy function, devaluing it.
The approveAndCall function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value can be of a large magnitude, causing an overflow in the buy function, devaluing it.
